svg.aria-label: Hero probe node wiring: ESP32 DevKit, probe, sensors, power
svg.text: Node A1 · hero probe node (ESP32 DevKit V1, 30-pin)
Pills are net names: every pill with the same name is the same wire.
VIN and USB: not used in battery mode
(pull JP1 and clip it in its place)
DHT11 instead: DATA → D26, 10 kΩ to 3V3
add 10 µF from VSYS to GND at the LDO input
Battery mode feeds the 3V3 pin directly. Switch SW1 off before plugging in USB, every time.
Pull the DevKit's power LED; then measure sleep current across JP1 with a multimeter on 200 µA.
